sections.title: Android
highlights: Open side chats, subagents, and previews beside the current conversation on wide Android layouts. Narrow layouts still open them full screen.

sections.title: Agent permissions
highlights: Show when Claude Auto is disabled for the current project, and explain whether the restriction comes from project, user, or organization settings.
Keep an existing chat usable when Claude cannot start in Auto by falling back to Supervised with a notice.

sections.title: Chats and workspaces
highlights: Keep the current line in view when a panel resizes a conversation just after it opens.
Use the destination project’s workspace default when moving a draft or routing it to another machine, while preserving a branch you choose.

sections.title: File previews and pull requests
highlights: Show zero columns for an empty OpenDocument sheet and display notebook output that is saved only as Markdown.
Use the Text language label for notebooks whose language metadata is blank.
Show the correct label for a one-byte SQLite BLOB.
Find pull requests from zero-padded numbers and mark files whose patch GitHub withheld.

sections.title: Command line
highlights: Reject negative message counts in thread show. A count of zero still shows thread details without messages.
